brief:
A mother documented footage of her young son Noah singing a lullaby while holding his younger brother Moh as an Israeli reconnaissance drone hummed overhead, Eye on Palestine reported. The video captures the child attempting to comfort his sibling amid the persistent sound of the aircraft.

The incident reflects the pervasive presence of Israeli military surveillance in Palestinian areas, where drone operations have become a constant feature of daily life for residents.
dek: Heartbreaking footage documented by a mother shows her young son, Noah, singing a lullaby and holding his little brother, Moh, tightly in his arms as the relentless buzz of an Israeli reconnaissance drone (“zanana”) echoes in the background.
title: Mother films son singing to brother as Israeli drone circles overhead
